verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an official MCP server that lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. The evidence is only a one-line summary, though, so the details beyond the core capability are not shown. Missing for 10: setup/connection instructions and supported clients or transports, the scope of exposed tools beyond flag creation and management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
